title: Bloom joins the CLI harness
summary:
Bloom got a CLI connection, large reference images got lighter, and chat requests got better at respecting what you asked for.

`polli harness` gained `bloom on`, `status`, and `off`, giving Bloom users a way to connect and disconnect Pollinations through the CLI.

Image requests now reuse valid base64 reference images instead of decoding and re-encoding them. That reduces memory use for large uploads, including Seedream reference images, while retaining existing size limits.

Explicit token limits and `parallel_tool_calls` settings now take precedence over defaults. A gateway update also adds support for Azure parallel tools, generic `top_k` forwarding, and Claude effort and JSON schema parameters. The API docs no longer claim that parallel tool calls default to `true`.

highlights.title: Connect Bloom with polli
highlights.text: Use `polli harness bloom on` to connect Bloom to Pollinations, check it with `status`, and disconnect with `off`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: More chat parameter support
highlights.text: Chat requests can forward `top_k` and use Claude effort and JSON schema parameters. Azure parallel tool calls are supported too. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
